entries.title: /api/boards returns the board list with ids and columns
creating a task persists it against the board
PATCH /api/tasks/:id/move moves a task to another column
POST /api/boards persists and the board is retrievable

step.title: every board has an id, a name and a columns array
GET /api/boards to pick an existing id
GET /api/boards/:id returns 200 with the same id
find a seeded board with columns
every returned task belongs to that board
read the seeded board and its first column
created task echoes title and priority
read the seeded tasks (skip when the board is empty)
find a board with two columns and a task (skip otherwise)
destination column holds the task; the others do not
every created column is linked to the new board
